green_summary.sole_archive_writer: lib/adapters/spec.js closeoutSpecs() is the only archive path: O_EXCL file lock (.spec-closeout.lock, wx flag) inside the change directory; a second concurrent writer is refused with ARCHIVE_WRITER_EXISTS — proven in-process AND from a real spawned child process (exit 3), and by two real child processes racing a full closeout (exactly one exit 0, the other ARCHIVE_WRITER_EXISTS or ARCHIVE_ALREADY_SEALED, exactly one archive directory). A completed archive refuses a second closeout (ARCHIVE_ALREADY_SEALED). The lock travels with the change directory into changes/archive/<date>-<change>/ and is released on completion and on every refusal path (never wedges the change).
green_summary.rehearsal_dry_run: rehearseArchive() computes the target summary against the REAL project, clones the complete openspec/ tree into a $TMPDIR throwaway project, runs the real host CLI there (openspec validate --strict --json, then openspec archive -y) and previews: parsed delta capabilities, a stable summaryDigest (canonical JSON over {change, capabilities, scope} where scope = sha256 over ALL openspec/specs files + the change dir), the CLI version, and expectedMainSpecs (byte digests of the clone's post-archive main specs). Proven side-effect-free: real change still present, real main specs byte-identical, no archive directory. Exit-0-with-abort ('Aborted. No files were changed.') is detected via the clone's authoritative state and reported as ok:false ARCHIVE_NOT_APPLIED — exit codes alone are never trusted.
green_summary.scenario_preservation: verifyScenarioPreservation() layer 2: for every MODIFIED requirement, every scenario present in the current main specs must exist in the delta (SCENARIO_DROPPED with the exact missing list); a MODIFIED target absent from main specs is MODIFIED_TARGET_MISSING. Layer 1 (native) is run for real: this suite PROVES openspec 1.3.1 passes a scenario-dropping delta through validate --strict AND archives it silently, losing the scenario ('Invalid login' disappears from main specs) — the adapter pre-check refuses the same delta before any archive with SCENARIO_PRESERVATION_VIOLATION, leaving the real project byte-identical. Two layers, honest about which one actually stops the loss.
green_summary.concurrent_drift_blocking: the summaryDigest binds delta files AND the entire main-specs tree; closeoutSpecs recomputes it under the lock and refuses with SPEC_DRIFT on any drift (B08: main-spec edit by another Change between rehearsal and closeout; also change-side edits, e.g. tasks.md). Adapter bookkeeping files are excluded from the scope. B08 THEN covered: after resolving the conflict and re-rehearsing, closeout succeeds and the old scenario survives in main specs.
green_summary.archive_interruption_recovery: recoverCloseout() decides from external state, never from the journal alone: pre-archive (change dir exists) — a dead writer's stale lock (pid proven dead via a real exited child) is reclaimed and the closeout re-runs to exactly one archive; post-archive (change dir consumed, one archive dir) — the CLI archive already synced specs and moved the change, so recovery does NOT re-archive and does NOT re-sync: it reads the main specs back (structural + vs archived deltas), finishes the journal to stage=complete and releases the moved lock; main specs byte-identical before/after recovery, exactly one archive dir. Readback failure (real corruption of main specs post-archive) keeps stage=readback-failed and reports the lost requirement by name. Multiple same-name archives refuse with AMBIGUOUS_ARCHIVE instead of guessing the newest.
green_summary.main_specs_readback: readBackMainSpecs() verifies post-archive main specs against the summary structurally (ADDED/MODIFIED requirement present with all delta scenarios and matching description; REMOVED absent) AND byte-level against the rehearsal clone's expectedMainSpecs (SPEC_BYTES_DRIFT with expected/observed digests). The A11 happy path asserts Invalid login preserved, Audit trail present, Legacy flow removed, byte-identity with the rehearsal, journal stage=complete with the Kp digest recorded, and lock released.
green_summary.no_duplicate_sync: the adapter never re-applies deltas: openspec archive contains the sync (verified: one CLI call updates specs AND moves the change). Post-archive recovery path performs zero spec writes (byte-identical assertion). closeoutSpecs after a completed archive refuses instead of converging (ARCHIVE_ALREADY_SEALED); rehearsing an archived change fails closed (ok:false, stage=summary).
green_summary.knowledge_closeout_ordering: Knowledge.Closeout.v1: closeoutSpecs refuses without a recorded Kp obligation ({id, digest: sha256}) — KNOWLEDGE_CLOSEOUT_REQUIRED before lock/archive; a bad digest and a missing execution identity (CLOSEOUT_EXECUTION_REQUIRED) are refused with nothing archived and main specs untouched.
